limitations: GO admits one producer and, only after its naturalPASS, one independent verifier. Actual full support, file bytes, quality replay, resource peaks and preservation remain unmeasured until those stages finish.

The original geometry retains known topology defects. A full vertex-colour GLB with saved-query gates does not establish watertightness, repair, exhaustive continuous-field agreement, renderer equivalence or game readiness.

All60 full-source batches are the one approved resampling operation. The independent verifier reuses saved original/holdout material targets and does not generate a second source-sampling population or fit colours.

Original and holdout gates concern their predeclared locations; holdout validation remains new-position validation on previously frozen faces, not face-disjoint validation. Native GPU bitwise parity is not claimed.

The1GiB/256MiB working/storage allowances are projections and preflight admission quantities. Unchanged enforced limits and live observation remain authoritative. Any actual export/verification failure must preserveNO-GO and stop without retry or alternate asset.
